verdict.rationale: Opting out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair question for a public web registry portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only records HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing documents any telemetry, cookie or tracking opt-out control, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
